technical-summary: Fixed a destructive PATH mutation in coding_lsp/_refresh_path_after_install(). It read the user-scope HKCU Environment PATH and assigned it directly over os.environ PATH, which discarded machine-scope and inherited entries (94 PATH entries collapsed to 51, losing C:/Program Files/nodejs) and left REG_EXPAND_SZ tokens like %LOCALAPPDATA% unexpanded so appended entries were inert. A function documented as picking up newly installed directories was removing working ones; in production any process that installs an LSP package loses the system PATH for the rest of its life, breaking later provider launches that need npx. Now expands REG_EXPAND_SZ and appends only genuinely new entries with case-insensitive dedupe, never replacing PATH. This was the true root cause of the three order-dependent test_as41_observability_tap_threading failures, which were misdiagnosed as feature-registry test pollution; tests/unit/coding_lsp runs before tests/unit/providers, so the corrupted PATH made build_acp_launch raise RES-PIACP-001. The unit suite is now down to one failure, the pi remote-MCP capability decision, which is deliberately left as a BLOCKING decision requiring a probe rather than a guessed capability flag.
user-summary-candidate: Fixed a bug where installing a language server could wipe the system PATH for the rest of the session.

technical-summary: Resolved the last AS71 failure as a Hindsight-provisioning decision and filed HM22. Hindsight ships an HTTP MCP server only, but provision.py routes six providers (antigravity, claude, cline, continue, gemini, qwen) to hindsight-managed-mcp-stdio.yaml, which registers command hindsight-mcp, a binary Hindsight does not ship and which the components own INSTALL_MAP.md already documents as nonexistent; those providers silently write an MCP entry that can only fail at harness launch. Only goose declares remote true and therefore actually works. pi has never declared remote, verified before and after the PC01-PC04 capability migration, and its recipe was authored eleven days after the guard that rejects it, so the recipe never worked and its test never passed. HM22 specifies deleting the stdio route so non-remote providers fall through to guidance-only, probing the currently-false providers to populate remote where proven, and carries the BLOCKING pi decision, which needs a Docker probe of whether pi-mcp-adapter honours a type http url entry in .mcp.json. Recorded a correction: an earlier claim in this session that goose lost its remote flag in the migration was wrong, caused by reading the wrong YAML path.
user-summary-candidate: Documented that Hindsight MCP setup silently writes a broken entry for six providers, and specified the fix.
